name: worldcreator_archive_module
description: Validate and archive an existing Module with the editor native implementation. Backs up the Module and top-level package first. Writes package GLB/meta and may normalize author meta. A completed archive does not confirm editor UI refresh.

name: worldcreator_asset_search
description: Search the signed-in native model library (public/personal/favorite), hydrating results for canvas_add_asset or pcg_select. Returns IDs and pagination, without signed URLs. staticOnly restricts to static models suitable for sprinkle.

name: worldcreator_canvas_add_asset
description: Place an already-loaded asset into the current scene root using the native editor pipeline. Returns new object IDs; use canvas_update to position and canvas_save to persist.

name: worldcreator_canvas_assets
description: List currently loaded editor asset library entries; use returned assetId for placement. Does not expose signed resource URLs.

name: worldcreator_canvas_capture
description: Capture the current editor viewport via its native renderer connection into a local PNG. Returns local filePath; does not publish or upload.

name: worldcreator_canvas_component_schema
description: Read component properties and native editable field schemas. Asset identity is read-only; unsupported field types are explicitly marked.

name: worldcreator_canvas_component_update
description: Patch an existing native component using its schema: appearance/material, physics, light, Text3DUI and other supported schema types. Read canvas_component_schema first; unknown fields/types are rejected. No arbitrary Unity AddComponent.

name: worldcreator_canvas_create_primitive
description: Create one native basic shape at scene root. Returns its ID; use canvas_update to place it and canvas_save to persist.

name: worldcreator_canvas_create_special
description: Create a native point light, spot light, 3D text or water object. Read returned object components, then edit via canvas_component_update.

name: worldcreator_canvas_debug
description: Read runtime object presence, world position, component types and script count, including during preview. Does not inspect Lua local variables or console logs.

name: worldcreator_canvas_delete
description: Delete scene objects and all descendants through native undoable actions. Does not delete library assets. Inspect IDs first and save separately.

name: worldcreator_canvas_focus
description: Select and focus a scene object in the actual editor viewport.

name: worldcreator_canvas_group
description: Combine two or more sibling objects into a native group. Returns the new group ID; save separately.

name: worldcreator_canvas_history
description: Undo or redo the latest native editor operation, including manual user edits. Read scene afterward. Never retry blindly.

name: worldcreator_canvas_import_glb
description: Import the specified local GLB (20 MiB maximum) through the signed-in editor normal upload pipeline into its asset library. This uploads the file to the editor service. Returns assetId; then call canvas_add_asset.

name: worldcreator_canvas_node
description: Read one object, editable components and bound scripts. Asset resource URLs are omitted.

name: worldcreator_canvas_pcg_status
description: Read map-generation session IDs and prerequisites. This tool does not generate terrain or publish a world.

name: worldcreator_canvas_physics
description: Patch existing PhysicsCollider fields using native component changes. Read canvas_node first. Numeric limits match editor UI.

name: worldcreator_canvas_preview
description: Read status, start or stop local runtime preview. Start may load avatar assets and executes scene scripts; no publishing. Scene mutations require stopping preview.

name: worldcreator_canvas_replace_asset
description: Replace one scene object with an already-loaded asset using native undoable replacement. Descendants and scripts are replaced. Returns a NEW instanceId and read-back transform; inspect it before further updates and save.

name: worldcreator_canvas_runtime_object
description: Read an active native runtime object by exact name, its position and up to 50 immediate child names. Useful for preview diagnostics; no code execution or modification.

name: worldcreator_canvas_save
description: Back up scene.data, invoke editor native save, verify clean save state and return persisted file SHA-256.

name: worldcreator_canvas_scene
description: Read actual open editor scene roots, IDs, transforms and save state. Set allNodes to include descendants (1000 maximum).

name: worldcreator_canvas_script_bind
description: Bind an existing valid project Lua script to one object with schema defaults and optional parameter overrides. Scripts run during preview; inspect script and target compatibility first.

name: worldcreator_canvas_script_params
description: Patch named parameters on an existing script binding; preserve other values and validate against registered schema.

name: worldcreator_canvas_script_unbind
description: Remove one script binding from an object without deleting its Lua source.

name: worldcreator_canvas_scripts
description: List registered project Lua scripts, parameter definitions and diagnostics.

name: worldcreator_canvas_terrain
description: Read active native terrain origin, size and sampled world heights for [x,z] points. Does not modify terrain. Use inside flag before placement.

name: worldcreator_canvas_ungroup
description: Dissolve a native group, preserving its children. Group root is removed. Inspect scripts on the root before dissolving.

name: worldcreator_canvas_update
description: Edit an existing canvas object by ID through native editor actions. Rotation uses local Euler degrees. Changes are undoable and require canvas_save to persist.

name: worldcreator_debug_capabilities
description: Report verified runtime debugging capabilities and missing Lua breakpoint/step/local-variable support. Does not substitute JavaScript CDP debugging for Lua debugging.

name: worldcreator_inspect_model
description: Inspect a Module using installed native tools. Runs trusted preview-module.js when present, otherwise reads GLB. Use node-tree first, or nodes with nodePaths ["" ] for the whole-model bounds. Does not intentionally write assets; source is executable JavaScript.

name: worldcreator_job_cancel
description: Request cancellation of a tracked PCG job. Native activation can be cancelled only when one new runtime graph is identifiable; partial scene changes remain. World uploads cannot be cancelled. Query job_status for final state.

name: worldcreator_job_status
description: Read a long-running native MCP job. Tracking survives MCP client reconnects but not renderer restarts; inspect PCG/world state after an editor restart.

name: worldcreator_list_files
description: List up to 1000 workspace files, optionally beneath a relative directory.

name: worldcreator_list_workspaces
description: List local projects and AI workspaces, excluding log folders. Use these identifiers for all workspace tools.

name: worldcreator_models
description: Read configured model IDs and agent defaults from the installed editor. Internal aliases do not identify the upstream model.

name: worldcreator_pcg_context
description: Read map session artifact IDs and statuses for terrain/sprinkle generation. Omits signed resource URLs.

name: worldcreator_pcg_select
description: Patch selected library model for known sprinkle overlay IDs; preserve other overlays. Requires pcg_selections revision, verifies static asset resources and uses native selection action. Does not generate; call pcg_start compose separately.

name: worldcreator_pcg_selections
description: Read completed sprinkle overlay IDs, selected model IDs and a revision for safe edits. Does not start generation.

name: worldcreator_pcg_start
description: Start native terrain generation, sprinkle parsing, map composition, or canvas activation. Cloud stages may consume credits. Use dryRun first. compose uses the existing sprinkle asset selections. Activation can replace scene content: requires explicit clearSceneConfirmed and creates scene.data backup. Returns asynchronous jobId; poll job_status, never retry with a new requestId after an uncertain result.

name: worldcreator_project_list
description: List signed-in homepage projects within the configured projects root. If homepage is closed, returns scope=open_project_only and just the current canvas. Editor must be started with MCP connection port.

name: worldcreator_project_open
description: Open an existing registered project using the native homepage service. Returns requested before canvas finishes loading; poll status. If a canvas is already open, only accepts that same project and never replaces or closes another project.

name: worldcreator_publish_prepare
description: Prepare a reviewable world upload plan without uploading. Validates saved scene, capacity, Lua diagnostics and metadata. Returns planId valid 10 minutes; scene changes invalidate it. Upload does not automatically mean public listing.

name: worldcreator_publish_status
description: Read world upload state; refresh=true queries the official service and reconciles completed remote processing into local status. Upload acceptance, remote processing and public listing are separate.

name: worldcreator_publish_submit
description: Upload the exact prepared world through the editor native account pipeline. Call only when the user authorizes uploading the reviewed world. Requires confirmed=true and prepared planId; returns jobId. Does not automatically publicly list the world; remote processing/review requires publish_status.

name: worldcreator_read_file
description: Read a UTF-8 workspace text file (1 MiB maximum) and its SHA-256 for optimistic writes.

name: worldcreator_script_files
description: List editable project scripts/modules Lua files with source SHA-256 and script IDs; excludes official/builtin code.

name: worldcreator_script_read
description: Read project modules/name.lua source and SHA-256. Preserve identity annotations when editing.

name: worldcreator_script_refresh
description: Refresh native Lua catalog and return scripts/diagnostics after external file edits. Does not run scripts.

name: worldcreator_script_write
description: Create/update project modules/name.lua. Null expectedSha256 creates only; updates require the current hash. Compiles Lua without execution, backs up prior bytes, preserves identity annotations and refreshes native catalog. New scripts receive IDs automatically. Scripts execute on next preview; inspect diagnostics before binding. No automatic preview or publishing.

name: worldcreator_settings_read
description: Read world rules, environment values, loaded templates, editable native schemas and revision. Unsupported asset-picker fields are marked read-only.

name: worldcreator_settings_update
description: Patch world rules or environment parameters through native editor actions. Read settings_read first and pass revision. Supports loaded template selection, sun/light, fog, weather and exposed scalar fields; preserve unrelated settings. Save canvas separately.

name: worldcreator_status
description: Report adapter availability and actual live-editor connection status.

name: worldcreator_validate_lua
description: Compile Lua 5.3 source without executing it, using the editor bundled compiler. Returns ok:false and error details for invalid syntax.

name: worldcreator_write_file
description: Create/update an author text file. Pass the last read SHA-256, or null for create-only. Prior bytes are backed up. Derived package/review files cannot be written.
